title: English
description: Original study material for Class IX English: Paper 1 (English Language) and Paper 2 (Literature in English).

syllabusBaselines.source: BoardPrep repository data file (data/icseEnglish.ts), recorded as based on the CISCE ICSE Examination Year 2027 English syllabus and Appendix I.
syllabusBaselines.note: Copied from the repository baseline and not re-checked against the official PDFs during this build (the official documents could not be fetched). Language entries are heading-level only; individual sub-topics are not verified. Confirm against the current CISCE documents before relying on it.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE ICSE Examination Year 2028 English syllabus and Appendix I (to be supplied and verified).
syllabusBaselines.note: A student who is in Class IX in 2026-27 sits the 2028 examination. The prescribed-text list for 2028 has not yet been verified, so no chapter is tagged to 2028.

sections.title: English Language
sections.description: Grammar, composition and comprehension skills, with worked examples and practice.

chapters.title: Tenses
chapters.blurb: Time and aspect: choosing the right tense form and avoiding the classic errors.

chapters.title: Subject-Verb Agreement
chapters.blurb: Making verbs agree with the true subject, including tricky cases.

chapters.title: Active and Passive Voice
chapters.blurb: Converting between voices across tenses without changing meaning.

chapters.title: Direct and Indirect Speech
chapters.blurb: Reporting statements, questions and commands with the correct changes.

chapters.title: Prepositions
chapters.blurb: Prepositions of time and place, and fixed word-preposition pairs.

chapters.title: Essay Writing
chapters.blurb: Planning and writing a clear, well-organised composition.

chapters.title: Letter Writing
chapters.blurb: Formal and informal letters: layout, tone and content.

chapters.title: Comprehension Skills
chapters.blurb: Reading closely, answering precisely, inference, vocabulary in context and summary.
